summary.executive_summary: This document is a circular issued by the Official Languages Wing of the Ministry of Law and Justice, India, proposing amendments to the Recruitment Rules for various Group 'B' posts. It outlines the specific roles subject to revision and establishes a formal consultation process for stakeholders to provide feedback. Stakeholders are granted a 30-day window to submit comments, after which silence will be interpreted as consent to the proposed changes. The circular also details the composition of the Departmental Promotion Committee for these roles.
key_points: Proposed amendment of Recruitment Rules for multiple Group 'B' posts within the Official Languages Wing.
Stakeholders are invited to submit comments or views on the draft provisions.
A strict 30-day deadline is imposed for the submission of feedback from the date of issue.
Failure to respond within the 30-day period will be deemed as having no objection to the proposed changes.
The document specifies the composition of the Departmental Promotion Committee, chaired by the Joint Secretary & Legislative Counsel.
favorable_clauses: The provision allowing for a 30-day consultation period provides stakeholders an opportunity to influence the regulatory framework before finalization.
unusual_clauses: The 'deemed consent' provision, which interprets a lack of response within 30 days as an explicit 'no objection' to the proposed amendments, is a significant administrative mechanism that shifts the burden of action entirely onto the stakeholders.
recommended_actions: Review the specific job descriptions and eligibility criteria for the listed Group 'B' posts to ensure they align with current organizational requirements.
Verify if the proposed changes to the Departmental Promotion Committee composition comply with existing Indian civil service regulations.
Ensure all relevant departments or stakeholders are notified immediately to meet the 30-day response deadline.
Document any objections or suggestions in writing and submit them to the Director (Admn.) before the expiration of the 30-day window.
Maintain a record of the submission to prove compliance with the consultation process.
